verdict.rationale: The pack contains no first-party evidence of a free tier, plan limits, or pricing terms. The docs show Mastra can run locally and deploy to Mastra Cloud, and a community comment mentions an Elastic v2 license, but neither documents a no-cost plan for prototyping tool connections. Another commenter notes the pricing page lists no prices, which leaves the free-tier question unanswered rather than confirmed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype my agent's tool connections on a meaningful free tier before paying anything
